customManagers.description: Update ARGs annotated with '# renovate: datasource=… depName=…'. Needed because the base images compose multiple ARGs in FROM (e.g. ${REGISTRY_DOCKERHUB}/library/rust:${RUST_VERSION}-slim-bookworm), which the dockerfile manager cannot auto-replace.

Update tool versions that composite actions pass as INPUT DEFAULTS (syft, cosign). Renovate's action manager pins the `uses:` ref but is blind to a version string handed to that action via `with:` — which is how syft sat on v1.21.0 from 2026-06-16 until v1.48.0 shipped, with nothing watching it.

packageRules.description: These Dockerfiles compose their FROM refs from multiple ARGs; the dockerfile manager resolves the ARGs at extraction but then cannot find the resolved string in the raw file ('Cannot find replaceString' → the whole branch silently produces no commit). The annotated-ARG custom manager above owns these deps instead.

The release toolchain (webgrip/workflows ADR-0005) is the one npm dependency set in this repo that is LOCKED, because it decides every repo's version numbers. These package.json files are also their image's release manifest — Renovate owns the dependencies; semantic-release owns the version. It upgrades as ONE reviewed PR across all three images — they must stay on the same semantic-release version, since the derived images replace the base's tree wholesale. A MAJOR bump is expected to FAIL the image build: each Dockerfile asserts the major that webgrip/workflows' composites target.
Annotated ARGs hold bare versions that are reused outside the FROM line (rustup default, tag suffix composition); appending @sha256 digests would corrupt them.
